content: तत्त्वम् (Sometimes written as तत्वम्) .²1 True state or condition, fact; वयं तत्त्वान्वेषान्मधुकर हतास्त्वं खलु कृती <ls>Ś. 1. 23</ls>. .²2 Truth, reality; न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते <ls>Bg. 9. 24</ls>. .²3 True or essential nature; संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम् <ls>Bg. 18. 1</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">3. 28</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 3</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">3. 96</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">5. 42</ls>. .²4 The real nature of the human soul or the material world as being identical with the Supreme Spirit pervading the universe. .²5 A true or first principle. .²6 An element, a primary substance; तत्त्वान्यबुद्धाः प्रतनूनि येन, ध्यानं नृपस्तच्छिवमित्यवादीत् <ls>Bk. 1. 18</ls>. .²7 The mind. .²8 Sum and substance. .²9 Slow time in music. .²10 An element or elementary property. .²11 The Supreme Being. .²12 A kind of dance. .²13 The three qualities or constituents of every thing in nature (सत्त्व, रजस् and तमस्). .²14 The body; तत्त्वाभेदेन यच्छास्त्रं तत्कार्यं नान्यथाविधम् <ls>Mb. 12. 267. 9</ls>.
